translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Borikine Mama Ŋei Eŋe Wakone Ŋei Wet Masiuk Okanone Geki Yesu Lotkeake
Kimakop, Waomze Yesu lotke lotkeinane so ŋenze eŋerop weneŋ maratnagu gege wane don iwa yale ŋidanmaile,

isi ŋei natne eŋe rakoi, Waom sariakane nasoine mo lotke more yuanŋunge, yale ra ŋidanbi ŋine ikopka wetŋineŋo misuk dere siukkei, me mi qisekei. Ŋinano ŋino ŋei natneŋo Asu wano more raikei, me ŋenane aŋao more ŋidanikei, me raikei edo kibiwo qe ŋebongoi, yale ŋidanikei.

Don kine kine yale, me yale ra isiŋunbi misuk desikei, Waom wane Naso ikopka mi bomileake, alakane miti Matali Qetali Mama Ŋei yewa wakone pakimo, Borikine Mama Ŋei eŋe gerep sorao wane biŋek, ketki zeakane didiwo wakoniake.

Eŋe baŋ ŋei eŋe yeye kine kine korop ea wane ra meŋenka okanmami, so ŋei eŋe yeye kine kine mayakatne ra okanmami, yewa ŋabaka wareake. Eŋe baŋ eŋine eŋetine mawa naguki paki, natne korop ebu ket biraoniake, paki Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo ari waketki paki pese mere eŋinane “na Anutu” rayake.
Na ŋinerop gekole, yewao iwa wane mo korop ŋidan warekole, ŋine ea mi detmami me?
Ŋo iwa yemo wakonbe rakimo, kine kine maneŋo leŋkamaike, ea ŋine mo detkamami, nasoine pamaike, yewao yemo Borikine Mama Ŋei, yewa eŋe baŋ didiwo wakoniake.
Borikine eŋe urata mo sanka ma okanmaike, ŋo tanik daleo wakoniake, eamo ikop mi wakoniake. Eŋe paki ŋei mane maŋo mainkaki zinge okanmaike, ea maki masikaniake.
Pakimo Borikine Mama eŋe baŋ didiwo wakongimo, Waom Yesu wane Asuineŋo aŋaino ŋine baŋ saketki paki qeake, paki didiwo sari lotkeakane qeli ewe zonomineŋo qe kito pelekki siukeake.
Borikine Mama Ŋei yewa, eŋe baŋ Satan wane zonom yewarop sariake, paki masi kine kine togole mayake, so tanik kine kine isisine so qotkoine kuneŋine mayake.
So ŋei midakei wane biŋek gemami, eŋe borikine maikei wane, wet masiuk okanoniake, eŋe midakei yemo onoka wane mida, eŋe don wele dere mena menaŋ yewa ŋadekka okanmami, ea wane midakei.
Kine iwa yalinane, Anutuŋo liwe liwek wane zonom suaine talekaki ket more, ŋei eŋane keueno urata maki, eŋe isi don wele midaine yewa dere malipkaikei.
Ea wane weleine yemo ŋei korop don wele dere mi malipka okanmami, ŋo eŋe siluŋ borikine simile det okanmami, ŋo eŋe siluŋ borikinane simile det okanmami, eŋe turuŋine wikile maratkaikei.
Anutuŋo Koso Ŋibuyakane Mo Ma Wakonŋunge

Kimakop, ŋine Waomŋo wet maep okanŋun okanmaike, ŋene ea wane ŋinane Anutu naso baŋem bakomine kito okanmaine, Anutuŋo mokaka koso ŋibuyakane ma wakon ŋunge, yemo Asu wane zonomŋo ŋibuki Anutu wane ŋei ŋerep magu libe libe okangoi, so mali malipŋineŋo don wele dere malip kakoi, yale okangoi wane, Anutuŋo koso ŋibuke.
Ŋene don maine ŋidangone yewao, Anutuŋo ŋidora newan ŋunge, eŋe newan ŋunge, yemo ŋine Waomze Yesu Kristo wane qeli ewe zonom yewa welaine okane ma gekeiwane.
Eso ea wane kimakop, ŋine togogole okorau paki, don wele kito ŋibongone, aŋaŋo ŋidangone, me kibiwo qe ŋibongone, yewa malilipka okorakei.
Waomze Yesu Kristo oŋom, so Anutu Magazeŋo wetmaep okan ŋonge, so eŋine wetne mayakakatnane wetpese papatogon yewa, ŋenane biŋek rake, ea toma kakenane ra ŋebonge.
Oŋo maine ŋinane kotoŋine maki qaeake, so ma togoleŋungi togole more urata maineka maikei, so don mayakatneka raikei.
